feature_contract.goal: Connect full-resolution native D3D11 per-eye color target binding and original OM/RS restoration to separately posed game-authored Draw/DrawIndexed stereo callbacks, then finish real R30 menu/car/race source replay to OpenXR with input-safe DX9Ex fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Renderer-owned left and right D3D11 draw passes bind the exact generation-owned per-eye RTV, full-target viewport and scissor, and issue native GPU writes without contaminating desktop RT.
Live game D3D9 Present and gamepad/FFB remain authoritative; original D3D11 OM/RS state is restored on completion and failure; stale/partial GPU submissions never reach OpenXR.

Distinct eye GPU outputs pass isolated WARP, exact producer EVENT, snapshot/ACK and five mandatory GitHub Actions checks; real R30 stereo replay, Quest3 visual and performance evidence remain separate.

integration_path: Wire exact generation-owned D3D11 ring eye RTV and eye-sized viewport/scissor to each renderer callback; restore pre-existing OM/RS state in all exit paths.
Keep original D3D9 game draw/Present/input fallback while native per-eye producer EVENT, OpenXR generation and ACK path remain isolated.
Remaining integrated source phase: connect actual R30 replay of menu, car selection and race Draw/DrawIndexed to both eye callbacks.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Material C++ adds live per-eye OM RTV output binding and WARP test verifies actual bound RT0, 64x64 eye viewport/scissor, distinct GPU eye pixel colors and producer EVENT.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Wrong pose or invalid callback rejected before GPU commands; unchanged partial-eye ring quarantine; native callback restores original desktop OM/RS bindings and leaves D3D9/gamepad/FFB untouched.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Native renderer callback -> ring RTV full-eye raster binding -> distinct GPU eye commands -> immutable snapshot/fence -> direct OpenXR host ACK.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Native per-eye RT0 binding source implemented and WARP-proven; genuine R30 menu/car/race replay into callbacks and actual HMD output are still unfinished.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Opt-in/fail-closed only. Original D3D9Ex Draw/Present/input/FFB authoritative. DXVK frozen.
remaining_implementation: R30 live game Draw/DrawIndexed stereo camera replay to production native eye callback
Full menu/car/race native frame source coverage and game/Quest3 runtime observation
